children: Tata Power Company Limited (NSE:TATAPOWER) is scaling domestic solar manufacturing and grid projects: backing a Rs 4,300 crore, 4.3 GW Tirunelveli module plant with advanced tech and a mainly female workforce, reporting H1 module/cell output growth, and awarding ₹200–300 crore EPC work for Mumbai substations.
: Tata Power (TATAPOWER) backs a 4.3 GW solar module plant in Tirunelveli via TPREL with ~Rs 4,300 crore investment, using TOPCon/Mono PERC cells, AI/ML systems, AGVs and a mainly female workforce
: Tata Power (TATAPOWER) TP Solar made 1.0 GW modules and 0.9 GW cells in Q2 FY27; H1 totals 2.0 GW modules, 1.8 GW cells. Modules meet Domestic Content Requirement and ALMM certification.
: Tata Power (TATAPOWER) awarded Bajel Projects an EPC contract worth ₹200–300 crore for 220 kV GIS substations at Salsette and Powai in Mumbai; 18-month execution from PO date.
